preconditions.description: The length of the string s is between 1 and 1000.
The integer k is between 1 and 26.

preconditions.expression: all('a' <= c <= 'z' for c in s)
preconditions.description: All characters in the string s are lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.description: The output is either the string 'impossible' or an integer.
It is impossible to have more than 26 different letters.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'impossible' if k > len(s) else True
postconditions.description: It is impossible to have more different letters than the length of the string.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 0 if len(set(s)) >= k else True
postconditions.description: No changes are needed if the string already contains at least k different letters.
The number of changes is non-negative.
